info.name: Azure Compute REST Availability Sets Virtual Machines API

description.content:
Azure Resource Manager (ARM) REST API for managing Azure compute resources
(virtual machines, virtual machine scale sets, disks, snapshots, images,
availability sets). Requests are sent to `https://management.azure.com` and
authenticated with Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens.
